steps.en: Install the system codec libraries and the project generator
steps.zh: 装好系统编解码库和项目生成器

steps.en: Scaffold a video project from a template
steps.zh: 用模板生成一个视频项目

steps.en: Generates a Rust crate: the video, a ready-made CLI, a media folder compiled into the binary
steps.zh: 生成 Rust 工程：视频本体、现成命令行、编进二进制的素材目录

steps.en: Write each frame as an SVG tree in Rust and animate values over time
steps.zh: 用 Rust 把每一帧写成 SVG 树，按时间给数值做动画

steps.en: Draws every frame on the GPU (Metal or Vulkan), reusing cached static markup
steps.zh: 在 GPU（Metal 或 Vulkan）上画出每一帧，静态标记直接复用缓存

steps.en: Encodes in-process with linked libav libraries and writes out.mp4
steps.zh: 在进程内用链接进来的 libav 库编码，写出 out.mp4

value.en: An MP4 straight from code with no browser in the loop — no headless Chrome screenshotting every frame
value.zh: 代码直接出 MP4，中间没有浏览器——不用再让无头 Chrome 一帧帧截图

sources: https://github.com/dmtrKovalenko/fframes README (Without an agent: cargo install --locked cargo-fframes, cargo fframes new my-video; Every command runs as `cargo run --release -- <command>`; render; Why it is fast: Skia on Metal/Vulkan, static markup cached, ffmpeg libav linked; What your agent writes: svgr!, timeline!)
https://github.com/dmtrKovalenko/fframes/blob/main/cargo-fframes/templates/README.md.tmpl (src/lib.rs, src/main.rs fframes::cli, media/ embedded; `render # the final video, writes out.mp4`)
https://github.com/dmtrKovalenko/fframes/blob/main/skills/fframes-video/SKILL.md (first build downloads prebuilt Skia and ffmpeg on macOS and Linux)
